review.reviewer: Refine04 pinned role-event census; W2R14 financial-oversight review

sources.label: KPMG independent financial audit, December 31, 2025 period, signed April 29, 2026

review.evidence: At block 26110197, exhaustive native role-event replay and hasRole checks establish two default-admin EOAs (0x407374be435ed278fca44be695d32f0230fe46e3, 0x5c943b2b881af70af571098a228d92cbcc2b5ba2) and two delegated MINTER_ROLE EOAs (0x7ba63cdc16abfbe4838eee04aff4150749a21bd8, 0xb99123ccab3e0110742cede9271953c6803947d4). No other explicit role grants occur; default administrators inherit all roles. Verified source establishes immediate UUPS upgrades and unbounded native minting. Legal shareholder registration supports internal-ledger reconciliation only. The on-chain census is closed; organizational identity, human independence and key-custody policies are not publicly attested. Organizational ownership, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policies of the four identified EOA controllers are not publicly attested. The September 14, 2026 prospectus tokenization section specifically discloses Administrator reconciliation of book-entry and blockchain transactions on at least a daily basis, triggered by a transaction, matching tokenized-share counts/ownership in the official register to Tokens on the Digital Platform. This supports internal-ledger only: it is token-to-share-register reconciliation, not a disclosed continuous or periodic supply-to-reserve financial reconciliation or independent financial assurance. W2R14 re-read the KPMG independent auditor report signed April 29, 2026: it expressly audits the USD sub-fund's statement of assets and liabilities and financial statements for July 17 through December 31, 2025 under Hong Kong Standards on Auditing. This establishes attestation-only independent financial oversight, not prudential supervision of minting or current whole-token supply-to-reserve reconciliation. SFC fund authorization is not used as prudential mint supervision.
